limitations: No general four-root or product exclusion.

collision_algebra.residual_formula: H coefficients in z=y-d are shifted_output[2:7]; full input/output coefficients are recorded for both zero collisions

actual_bounds.reference_roots: four distinct simple roots for each t, by four disjoint IVT brackets
actual_bounds.F_real_roots: at least four distinct, by strict threshold order and IVT
actual_bounds.collision_residual_real_roots: four distinct simple roots whenever F=(y-d)^2 H
actual_bounds.witness: none in this fixed R family for one quadratic symbol

required_bounds.whole_target: input two nonreal roots and output four, all saved restrictions
required_bounds.family: a root-free residual or separately certified pair-removing perturbation; neither exists if the interval checks pass
